entries.description: Read stub spec, prerequisite Set B UAT checklist, and project-guidance.md; verified API keys.

Spliced fleshed-out Session Plan (8 sessions), Risk notes, and Exit criteria into spec.md. Round-2 cross-provider verification after fixing three Minor round-1 issues. Verifier: opus.

Diagnosed UAT finding 1. Root cause: UsersMasterGrid.OnInitializedAsync and UserRoleAssignmentDetails.OnInitializedAsync run concurrently during the initial Users-tab render. Both call through AdminUserQueryService, which held a scoped DabblerSecurityDbContext. Concurrent awaits on the same EF context throw 'A second operation was started on this context instance', followed by an ObjectDisposedException from the RemoteRenderer once the circuit unwinds.

Refactored AdminUserQueryService to depend on IDbContextFactory<DabblerSecurityDbContext>. Each public method now creates a fresh context via `await using var db = await _dbFactory.CreateDbContextAsync(ct)`. Internal helper `LoadActorAssignedOrganizationIdsAsync(db, ct)` reuses the caller's context so GetUsersAsync still runs its two queries on a single context instance while GetActorAssignedOrganizationIdsAsync (called from UserRoleAssignmentDetails) creates its own context — eliminating the concurrent-await collision. Updated 5 unit tests in AdminUserQueryServiceTests.cs to supply a factory and added a new ConcurrentCallsDoNotThrow regression guard that issues three parallel service calls and asserts no exception.

Added AddDbContextFactory<DabblerSecurityDbContext> to AddDabblerSecurity in ServiceCollectionExtensions.cs alongside the existing AddDbContext call. Registered with ServiceLifetime.Scoped so it remains compatible with the scoped DbContextOptions<T> produced by AddDbContext — the default Singleton lifetime triggered 'Cannot consume scoped service DbContextOptions from singleton IDbContextFactory' in the 16 WebApplicationFactory-backed Web tests. Also changed UseEfCoreStore's pre-existing factory registration to Scoped for consistency even though it is not exercised by the current Web host (UseJsonFileStore is the active path). Audited sibling Blazor EF consumers: OrganizationMasterGrid and OrganizationDetailsForm inject scoped DabblerSecurityDbContext directly but do not trigger concurrent initial awaits (OrganizationMasterGrid's OnInitializedAsync is the only initial query; OrganizationDetailsForm queries only on user selection). Flagged for the verifier but deliberately left out of scope — Session 4 will restructure OrganizationMasterGrid for in-circuit refresh and is the natural owner of any further factory migration there.

Created tests/AcmeCoffeeOnline.Playwright/SecurityDashboardUatCoverageTests.cs with three tests covering UAT finding 1: UsersTab_LoadsForSystemAdmin_NoCircuitCrashAsync (the core regression guard), UsersTab_LoadsForSystemAdmin_GridProjectsSeededRowsAsync (operability proof that seeded rows render), and UsersTab_RapidRemountDoesNotCrashAsync (defensive remount under the original concurrent-init pressure; uses Force=true on tab-strip clicks because the MudTabs re-render leaves a transient pointer-event overlay — the test's purpose is regression-guarding the DbContext fix, not proving tab-click UX). Each test method carries a `// UAT:` cross-reference comment per the newly promoted Human UAT Philosophy convention. Scaffold generated via route(task_type='test-generation') → gemini-pro; applied with minor stylistic cleanups (using-before-namespace ordering, non-nullable page var, Assertions.Expect style matching existing files).

Build green (0 errors; expected [Obsolete] cascade warnings). Non-Playwright test suite: 668 passed / 0 failed across 6 assemblies (Dabbler.Components 33, Dabbler.Reports.Blazor 13, Dabbler.Security.Blazor 192, AcmeCoffeeOnline.Api 27, Dabbler.Security 280 — +1 from baseline for the new ConcurrentCallsDoNotThrow test, AcmeCoffeeOnline.Web 123). Playwright Security Dashboard regression set: 14 passed / 0 failed across four classes (SecurityDashboardUatCoverageTests x3 new, SecurityDashboardFiveTabSmokeTests x2, UsersAndRoleAssignmentWorkflowTests x1, SecurityDashboardFullSweepTests x8). Full Playwright suite not run on this session (explicitly scoped by spec risk notes to the dashboard coverage since that is the regression surface the DbContextFactory change touches); broader regression falls to Session 3 and Session 4 as new behaviour lands.
Cross-provider verification via task_type=session-verification. Verifier: opus.

Addressed four Minor round-1 issues: replaced placebo ConcurrentCallsDoNotThrow test with a CountingDbContextFactory-backed EachPublicMethodResolvesItsOwnDbContext wiring assertion; extracted ConfigureSecurityDbContext local function to eliminate the duplicated DbContext configuration lambda; ran the full Playwright suite; disclosed that UserRoleAssignmentDetails.razor was unchanged despite the spec's pessimistic 'Touches' listing.
Round-2 cross-provider verification after the four Minor round-1 fixes. Verifier: opus.

Closed UAT Finding 2 (Security nav hidden for non-SystemAdmin). Added CanReachSecurityDashboard field to ShellSessionState (computed via BakedInRoles.All) in ShellSessionStateLoader.cs; restructured the Admin nav group in MainLayout.razor so the Security Dashboard link surfaces for any baked-in role holder. Tab visibility remains a compiled-privilege decision (no Session 3 change to DabblerPageAuthorize or user-roles.json). This was carried over from the prior-attempt session (Sonnet 4.6 Max) that ran out of context before shipping.

Added four Playwright tests in SecurityDashboardUatCoverageTests.cs using explicit roles: override: SecurityNav_SystemAdmin_NavVisible_And_FiveTabsAsync, SecurityNav_CrossOrgUserAdmin_NavVisible_And_ThreeTabsAsync, SecurityNav_BakedInUser_NavVisible_And_RoleDocOnlyAsync, and UsersTab_LoadsForCrossOrgUserAdmin_NoCircuitCrashAsync (Session 2 regression re-run on the newly-permitted persona).

Fixed a .NET 10 Docker infrastructure bug blocking every Playwright test (99/99 failing on /_framework/blazor.web.js 404). Root cause: Dockerfile.Web's publish step used --no-restore after a csproj-only restore â€” under .NET 10 SDK (confirmed 10.0.201) that suppresses Blazor static-asset discovery and leaves blazor.web.js out of wwwroot/_framework/ and the static-web-assets endpoints manifest. The same source under .NET 11 preview SDK publishes correctly, which masked the bug locally (dev machine had 11.0.100-preview.2). Fix: dropped --no-restore from docker/Dockerfile.Web. Also adopted the canonical .NET 10 Blazor template pattern in Program.cs and App.razor â€” removed UseStaticFiles(), moved MapStaticAssets() adjacent to MapRazorComponents() in the endpoint section, switched the <script> tag to the @Assets[] helper. Diagnosed via: curl /_framework/blazor.web.js from inside the playwright container, copying the publish manifest out via docker cp, and replicating the Dockerfile staged restore pattern in an ad-hoc SDK container to isolate the culprit.

Fixed two more pre-existing Docker infrastructure issues surfaced once the blazor.web.js 404 was resolved. (a) /test-auth/* endpoints returned 403 for playwright â†’ web requests because IsLoopbackOrInMemoryRequest rejects bridge-network traffic. Added Authentication:SeededSession:AllowNonLoopback opt-in (defaults to false; takes effect only when Development or Test and SeededSession:Enabled=true) and enabled it via env var in docker-compose.yml for the web service. Endpoint guards now bypass the loopback check when the flag is set while still enforcing the shared secret. (b) web service inherited the LocalDB connection string from appsettings.Development.json (api had been overridden; web had not), causing PlatformNotSupportedException â†’ HTTP 500 on every authenticated request. Added ConnectionStrings__DefaultConnection env var to the web service in docker-compose.yml matching the api's sqlserver connection string.

Full Docker Playwright suite: 95 passed / 4 failed out of 99 (prior baseline: 1 passed / 98 failed). All 9 Session 3-relevant tests passed (7 SecurityDashboardUatCoverageTests + 2 SecurityDashboardFiveTabSmokeTests). The 4 remaining failures are pre-existing Docker-specific bugs previously masked by the blazor.web.js 404 and are not caused by Session 3's changes: SmokeTests.AdminNavigation_UsesFocusedProductsEntryAndActualRolePermissionsAsync (access-denied assertion on /admin/products), RestrictionEnforcementTests.CustomerRole_SeesUnitPriceFieldButReadOnlyAsync (HTTP 500 on /products/17 via web â†’ api 401), OrdersWorkflowTests.OrderDetail_SystemAdmin_CanEditNotesAndPersistAsync (sqlserver state pollution between runs), EdgeCaseTests.AccessDenied_CustomerRole_BlockedFromCustomersPageAsync (access-denied UI contract drift). Filed as Finding 10 in spec.md with Session 4 Step 0 triage assignment so they are not indefinitely deferred. Non-Playwright build + test suites stayed green.

Cross-provider verification via task_type=session-verification, max_tier=2 to route to a non-Anthropic provider (Sessions 1 and 2 used opus). Verifier: gemini-pro. Verdict: Pass â€” no issues raised. Raw review saved to session-reviews/session-003.md. One benign observation: the DatabaseInitializer.cs MigrateAsync â†’ EnsureCreatedAsync change (a prior-attempt Session 3 Docker fix that also shipped in this commit) was noted as low-risk and non-regressive.

Step 0 pre-scope triage of Finding 10.1-10.4: (10.1) SmokeTests.AdminNavigation_UsesFocusedProductsEntryAndActualRolePermissionsAsync — updated two stale assertions that expected BackofficeUserAdmin access-denied on /admin/products (Set A Session 3 opened it) and /admin/security (Session 3 of this set opened it); both now assert ToHaveCountAsync(0). (10.2) RestrictionEnforcementTests.CustomerRole_SeesUnitPriceFieldButReadOnlyAsync — marked [Fact(Skip = ...)] with rationale pointing to Session 5 restriction-seam reachability (Finding 4); same Docker-principal / restriction-seam failure mode. (10.3) OrdersWorkflowTests.OrderDetail_SystemAdmin_CanEditNotesAndPersistAsync — simplified the edit path to overwrite with a unique marker rather than append to originalNotes, eliminating cross-run accumulation under sqlserver state pollution. (10.4) EdgeCaseTests.AccessDenied_CustomerRole_BlockedFromCustomersPageAsync — replaced stale GetByRole(Link, Go to sign in) assertion with GetByTestId(access-denied-back-button) to match the current AccessDeniedCard contract. Spec updated with triage outcomes.

Fixed Finding 3 primary root cause: CustomerService.ApplyOrganizationScope compared _currentUser.Role against UserRole.SystemAdmin only — the AcmeCoffee UserRole enum does not include CrossOrgUserAdmin or CrossOrgMonitor, so those baked-in roles fell through to the  branch which returned  — silently starving them of all customer rows. Fix: added IReadOnlyList<string> RoleNames to ICurrentUserService (reads AppUserRoles items or ClaimTypes.Role claims), registered OrganizationScopeFilter as singleton in Dabbler.Security AddDabblerSecurity, then rewrote CustomerService.ApplyOrganizationScope and OrganizationOptionsService.GetOptionsAsync to use OrganizationScopeFilter.CanBypassOrganizationScope + IBakedInRoleProvider. Internal user-type roles without a CustomerId now fall through to all-customers (OrganizationScopeFilter.DeferredReason documents the Set C deferral). Build is green; API only.

Investigated Finding 3 sub-issue (Key contains  returns nothing). Traced the filter pipeline end-to-end: FilterPanel<T> passes raw MudTextField value through FilteringCoordinator as object?; OrganizationMasterGrid.ApplyFilter uses string.Contains(needle, OrdinalIgnoreCase). No tokenization or escape handling that would mis-treat dashes. Seed keys are  style, so  is correctly not a substring; , , and  all are. Added Grid_FilterByKeyContains_HandlesDashCharacter (theory, 4 rows) to OrganizationMasterGridTests.cs locking down the semantics. Spec updated with the clarification — this is a seed-data-shape observation, not a tokenization defect.

Refactored OrganizationMasterGrid and OrganizationDetailsForm to IDbContextFactory per the Session 2 pattern. Each Load/Save/Archive now awaits its own DabblerSecurityDbContext, eliminating any stale identity-map entries the shared scoped context could leave between the tracked-edit path and the AsNoTracking grid-refresh projection. The existing Persisted -> RefreshAsync wiring in OrganizationMasterDetailsTab was already in place; the factory refactor is the enabling piece that makes the refresh reliably reflect the latest row. Test helpers in OrganizationMasterGridTests.cs, OrganizationDetailsFormTests.cs, and DabblerSecurityDashboardTests.cs each gain a TestDbContextFactory implementing IDbContextFactory<DabblerSecurityDbContext> bound to the same in-memory options used for the scoped context registration.

Added four Playwright tests to SecurityDashboardUatCoverageTests.cs for Session 4 coverage: Customers_CrossOrgUserAdmin_SeesAllRetailCustomersAsync (asmith vs admin totalCount equality), Customers_BackofficeUser_SeesCustomersInsteadOfEmptySetAsync (jdoe non-zero), OrgMasterDetails_FilterKeyContainsDash_ShowsRetailRowsInCircuitAsync (filter  narrows grid in-circuit, and  correctly yields zero rows as a literal .Contains check), OrgMasterDetails_CreateOrganization_GridRefreshesInCircuitAsync (new row appears without browser reload). Each method carries a // UAT: block naming persona + seeded parameters matching the Session 8 checklist shape.

Repaired three regressions uncovered by the Finding 3 fix: (a) AdminUserScopeTests.SystemAdmin_CanGrantScopedUserAdmin_AndCustomerRowsFollowActiveOrganizationAsync — the old assertion  encoded the bug the fix removes; replaced with a positive assertion plus an inline comment pointing at OrganizationScopeFilter.DeferredReason / Set C. (b) WebGuardrailTests.PlatformStubRoute_RendersReusableStubHostProofAsync — Session 3 switched App.razor to @Assets[_framework/blazor.web.js] which MapStaticAssets may fingerprint; assertion relaxed to Assert.Matches against _framework/blazor.web*.js. (c) DabblerSecurityDashboardTests — added DashboardTestDbContextFactory registration alongside the existing scoped DbContext so OrganizationMasterGrid and OrganizationDetailsForm can resolve their new IDbContextFactory dependency.
Cross-provider verification via task_type=session-verification, max_tier=2 to route to a non-Anthropic provider (Sessions 1 and 2 used opus, Session 3 used gemini-pro). Verifier: gemini-pro.

Diagnosed UAT Finding 4. Root cause: security-config.json listed '/products' with ControlKey='*' Kind='Hidden' for BackofficeUser, so PageAuthorizationHandler returned false before the RestrictedFormField / RestrictedGridColumn seam in ProductList.razor + ProductDetail.razor could render degraded variants. WarehouseUser had no page-level block at '/products' but also had no seeded AppUser persona with a WarehouseUser AppRole assignment. Chose Strategy B from the spec's two options: move the seam page onto a route the target roles can reach. The seam already lives at '/products' + '/products/{id}'; '/admin/products' stays admin-only because it is admin CRUD, not the restriction-seam demo. The existing '/admin/products' Hidden entries for BackofficeUser and WarehouseUser are preserved.

Replaced the BackofficeUser page-wide '/products' Hidden UiRestriction with two ControlKey-scoped entries (CreateProductButton, EditPriceButton) matching the existing Customer pattern, in both src/Apps/AcmeCoffeeOnline.Web/security-config.json AND src/Apps/AcmeCoffeeOnline.Api/security-config.json. '/admin/products' stays page-wide Hidden for BackofficeUser. Customer's existing entries are unchanged. WarehouseUser's entries are unchanged (no '/products' page-level block to remove). Decision rationale captured in Step 6 verification prompt.

src/Apps/AcmeCoffeeOnline.Api/Data/SeedData.cs: appended 'WarehouseUser' to GetSecurityRoles() so the config-only role gets a backing AppRole row for AppUserRole assignments; added 'warehouse@acmecoffee.com' (internal-staff membership + WarehouseUser role) and 'customer@acmecoffee.com' (bridged to customer-1 so UserSessionContextService.TryResolveCustomerId yields ActiveCustomerId=1 + Customer role). Finding 10.2's original 'Docker bridge' theory was wrong — the root cause was that customer@acmecoffee.com was never in SeedData, so BuildAsync found no AppUser row and the downstream api call returned 401. Seeding closes that gap.

No implementation change needed — the RestrictedFormField / RestrictedGridColumn seam in ProductList.razor and ProductDetail.razor already honours ColumnRestriction ViewOnly (PropertyColumn Editable=false + MudNumericField Disabled/ReadOnly) and Hidden (no column / no field render). The Session 5 fix is purely configuration + seeding — opening the route and giving the target roles real personas the seam can resolve against.

tests/AcmeCoffeeOnline.Playwright/SecurityDashboardUatCoverageTests.cs: added 7 Session 5 tests with '// UAT:' cross-reference comments — Products_BackofficeUser_ReachesListWithoutAccessDeniedAsync, Products_BackofficeUser_UnitPriceColumn_IsNotEditableAsync, Products_BackofficeUser_UnitPriceField_IsDisabledOnDetailAsync, AdminProducts_BackofficeUser_StillDeniedAsync (regression guard that /admin/products stays admin-only), Products_WarehouseUser_UnitPriceColumn_AbsentFromGridAsync, Products_WarehouseUser_UnitPriceField_AbsentFromDetailAsync, Products_CustomerPersona_UnitPriceField_IsDisabledOnDetailAsync. tests/AcmeCoffeeOnline.Playwright/RestrictionEnforcementTests.cs: unskipped CustomerRole_SeesUnitPriceFieldButReadOnlyAsync and rewrote the comment to document the corrected root cause (persona was never seeded, not a Docker-bridge principal issue).

dotnet build Dabbler.Platform.sln: 0 errors, 183 warnings (all expected [Obsolete] cascades). dotnet test Dabbler.Platform.sln --no-build --filter FullyQualifiedName!~Playwright: 672 passed / 0 failed across 6 assemblies (Dabbler.Reports.Blazor 13, Dabbler.Components 33, Dabbler.Security.Blazor 196, AcmeCoffeeOnline.Api 27, AcmeCoffeeOnline.Web 123, Dabbler.Security 280). First run against the stale pre-Session-5 localdb threw a duplicate-key exception during EnsureMembershipsAsync on a (UserId=68, OrganizationId=1) tuple — this was a one-time reconciliation artefact against a dev-only SQL Server localdb; re-running the suite got 672/0. Fresh Docker SQL Server containers (used by the Playwright suite) initialise from empty so the artefact does not recur there.

Docker Playwright suite over two consecutive fresh-container runs: 109 passed / 1 failed / 110 total each run. Session 5's 7 new SecurityDashboardUatCoverageTests and the unskipped RestrictionEnforcementTests.CustomerRole_SeesUnitPriceFieldButReadOnlyAsync all passed both runs. All pre-Session-5 tests preserved (Sessions 2-4 regression targets + RestrictionEnforcementTests SystemAdmin + WarehouseUser role-override tests). Single failure is a pre-existing MultiOrganizationWorkflowTests timing flake inside PlaywrightFixture.SwitchOrganizationFromShellAsync (line 281): run 1 failed E2E_WF_01_RegionalSalesRep; run 2 failed E2E_WF_02_DualMembershipUser. Same signature (switchedSession.ActiveOrganizationName returned pre-switch 'Internal Operations' instead of the expected retail business name). Different test fails on different run under identical seed/config → server-side org-switch round-trip cookie settle is racing with GetSessionInfoAsync. Independent of Session 5 changes; disclosed in the verifier prompt out-of-scope section.

Deleted the sensitive-name safety-net feature per the newly-promoted Principle (trust business + auditor backstop over auto-detection tooling). Removed: src/Libs/Dabbler.Security.Blazor/Components/Admin/Masks/SensitiveNameSafetyNet.razor (the entire component with its regex patterns ssn/taxid/ein/dob/password/ccnum/salary), the '<SensitiveNameSafetyNet>' embed + Rebuild callback from DefaultMasksTab.razor, the safety-net prefill helper 'AddFromSafetyNetAsync' from DefaultMasksGrid.razor, tests/Dabbler.Security.Blazor.Tests/Components/Admin/Masks/SensitiveNameSafetyNetTests.cs (5 tests), the two safety-net tests from DefaultMasksGridTests.cs, the 3 safety-net tests from DefaultMasksTabTests.cs, and the Playwright SensitiveNameSafetyNet_AddButton_DeclaresColumnInDefaultMasksAsync test. No separate scanner service existed — logic was component-local.

Finding 5a: Customer.SocialSecurityNumber now flows through to the Default Masks Column dropdown. Root cause: the Web and Api Program.cs entity registrations for Customer did not include a SocialSecurityNumber field, so Metadata.GetColumns('Customer') returned a field list without SSN and the dropdown rendered no such option. Added fields.Add('SocialSecurityNumber', 'SSN') to the Customer entity registration in both src/Apps/AcmeCoffeeOnline.Web/Program.cs and src/Apps/AcmeCoffeeOnline.Api/Program.cs. The seeded Customer.SocialSecurityNumber DefaultMask row (from Set B Session 3) now resolves its column display name to 'SSN' instead of falling back to the raw key.

Finding 5b: Role Master Details > Data Column Restrictions > Add button was silently disabled when the user selected a (Table, Column) pair that already carried a restriction. Root cause was the duplicate-guard in CanAdd denying the Add with no UX cue — the UAT tester picked BackofficeUser + Product.UnitPrice which is already ViewOnly. Fix: added a new AvailableColumns computed property to ColumnRestrictionsSubTab.razor that filters Metadata.GetColumns(_newTableKey) to only columns without an existing restriction for this role. The Column dropdown now only offers selectable pairs, so the duplicate-guard never needs to fire and the Add button reliably transitions enabled once both dropdowns have values. CanAdd itself is preserved as a defence-in-depth guard. Applied the same filter pattern to DefaultMasksGrid.razor for symmetry, using the DefaultMasks list instead of Role.ColumnRestrictions.

Finding 5c: Default Masks / Column Restrictions table dropdown now shows singular entity names. Root cause: the DisplayName argument in options.RegisterEntities(entities.Add('Customer', 'Customers', ...)) was the plural DbSet form. Changed to singular in both src/Apps/AcmeCoffeeOnline.Web/Program.cs and src/Apps/AcmeCoffeeOnline.Api/Program.cs: 'Products' -> 'Product', 'Customers' -> 'Customer', 'Orders' -> 'Order', 'Order Items' -> 'Order Item', 'Order Notes' -> 'Order Note'. The MetadataRegistry is the single source for both dropdowns (DefaultMasksGrid and ColumnRestrictionsSubTab) so the change flows through to both. Grid cell display via ResolveTableDisplay picks up the new singular form for existing rows too.

Added 6 new Playwright tests to SecurityDashboardUatCoverageTests.cs (one per Finding 5 sub-item plus the 'already-restricted columns hidden from dropdown' regression guard): DefaultMasks_SafetyNetPanel_AbsentFromTabAsync (5d), DefaultMasks_SeededSsnRow_RendersSingularTableAndSsnColumnAsync (5a grid-render path + 5c grid-render path), DefaultMasks_TableDropdown_ShowsSingularEntityNamesAsync (5c full dropdown path), DefaultMasks_AddPhoneMask_PersistsAndRendersInGridAsync (5a fresh-add path), ColumnRestrictions_AddButton_EnabledForFreshPair_AndRowPersistsAsync (5b enabled/persist path), ColumnRestrictions_AlreadyRestrictedColumn_HiddenFromDropdownAsync (5b dropdown-filter guard). First run hit AriaRole.Option failures on 4 of 6 because MudBlazor 8.15 does not reliably expose the options under role=option; added explicit data-testid attributes to MudSelectItem elements (pattern 'default-mask-table-option-{key}' and 'column-restriction-table-option-{key}' / '-column-option-{key}') and switched the tests to GetByTestId per the UserRoleAssignmentDetails precedent. Each test carries a // UAT comment. Also added a bUnit test ColumnDropdown_ExcludesAlreadyRestrictedColumns asserting the AvailableColumns helper filters pre-restricted columns.

dotnet build Dabbler.Platform.sln: 0 errors, 184 warnings (all expected [Obsolete] cascades from Set B). dotnet test non-Playwright: 663 passed / 0 failed across 6 assemblies (Dabbler.Components 33, Dabbler.Reports.Blazor 13, Dabbler.Security.Blazor 187 -- -5 from session 5 baseline reflecting the deletion of 5 safety-net tests net +3 from the new ColumnDropdown_ExcludesAlreadyRestrictedColumns and DefaultMasksTab renders-without-safety-net tests, AcmeCoffeeOnline.Api 27, Dabbler.Security 280, AcmeCoffeeOnline.Web 123). Docker Playwright suite two runs: run 1 115/110 passed with 5 failed (4 of my Session 6 tests failed on AriaRole.Option + 1 pre-existing DashboardCards_ timing flake); fixed by adding data-testid attributes to MudSelectItems (pattern 'default-mask-table-option-{key}', 'default-mask-column-option-{key}', 'column-restriction-table-option-{key}', 'column-restriction-column-option-{key}') and switching tests to GetByTestId per the UserRoleAssignmentDetails precedent; run 2 115/113 passed with 2 failed. Both remaining failures are the same pre-existing MultiOrganizationWorkflowTests.SwitchOrganizationFromShellAsync flake documented in Session 5 -- Expected 'Retail Business 001' Actual 'Internal Operations', line 281 of PlaywrightFixture.cs, the org-switch cookie-settle race. All 6 new Session 6 Playwright tests (5 UAT coverage + 1 regression guard) plus every Session 2-5 test passed on run 2.
Cross-provider verification via task_type=session-verification, max_tier=2 to route to a non-Anthropic provider (Sessions 1-2 used opus, Sessions 3-5 used gemini-pro). Verifier: gemini-pro.

Removed the dashboard tab-strip arrow-key navigation per UAT Finding 9 ('Let's not do fancy stuff with the keyboard events'). Dropped the @onkeydown attribute from DabblerSecurityDashboard.razor's outer div, deleted HandleTabKeyDown and NextPanelIndex (and the Microsoft.AspNetCore.Components.Web @using which was only required by the handler). Deleted three arrow-key bUnit tests and the NextPanelIndex theory (9 inline data cases) from DabblerSecurityDashboardTests.cs. Deleted the Playwright TabStrip_ArrowKeys_AdvanceAndWrapAcrossAllFiveTabsAsync test from SecurityDashboardFullSweepTests.cs. MudBlazor default tab behaviour and Tab-key focus progression remain.

Built src/Libs/Dabbler.Security.Blazor/Components/Admin/Shared/MasterDetailExpansionShell.razor as the shared idiom-A wrapper. Parameters: TestId (data-testid root), IsExpanded + IsExpandedChanged for two-way binding, ExpandedHeaderText, CollapsedSummaryText, optional CollapsedSummaryBadge (for the baked-in chip on Role Master Details), ScrollMaxHeight (default 24rem) so the inner MudExpansionPanel content respects the ~6-row viewport the plan requires, and ResultsContent RenderFragment. Added four bUnit tests (MasterDetailExpansionShellTests.cs) covering expanded header, collapsed summary + badge, collapsed without badge, and blank-summary fallback to expanded header text.

Wrapped RoleMasterGrid in MasterDetailExpansionShell inside RoleMasterDetailsTab.razor. State transitions: _isResultsExpanded starts true; selection -> collapsed + summary 'Role: {CanonicalName}' plus 'baked-in' badge for baked-in rows; deselect -> expanded + cleared summary; OnSubTabPersisted still calls grid Rebuild. Fixed UAT Finding 8 DisplayAlias clipping: added CellStyle max-width:220px with overflow:hidden + text-overflow:ellipsis on the Display alias TemplateColumn; pinned the MudTextField font-size to 0.875rem via Style so it matches the Typo.body2 surrounding copy; set width:100% on the field; added a (no alias) placeholder so empty cells read as intentional rather than blank.

Wrapped OrganizationMasterGrid in MasterDetailExpansionShell inside OrganizationMasterDetailsTab.razor. Added an _isCreatingNew boolean so the OrganizationMasterGrid's 'new organization' click (which internally fires both CreateRequested and SelectedOrganizationIdChanged(null)) does not collapse-then-immediately-reset the shell state: CreateRequested sets the flag, SelectedOrganizationIdChanged(null) skips the reset while the flag is set, OnPersistedAsync clears it. Selection -> collapsed + summary 'Organization #{id}'; new organization -> collapsed + summary 'New organization' (the explicit cue UAT Finding 6 asked for); save -> keep collapsed, summary refreshed from persisted id; filter-change handling preserved from the grid itself.

Wrapped UsersMasterGrid in MasterDetailExpansionShell inside UsersAndRoleAssignmentTab.razor. State: selection -> collapsed + summary 'User: {DisplayName}'; deselect -> expanded + cleared summary. UserRoleAssignmentDetails stays below the shell so the role-assignment edit surface remains visible while the results grid is collapsed. RolesChanged callback unchanged -- the grid's internal RefreshAsync plus its own SelectedUserChanged re-fire drive in-circuit grid projection.

Wrapped DefaultMasksGrid in MasterDetailExpansionShell inside DefaultMasksTab.razor using the plan's lighter variant. Collapsed summary is rule-count aware: 'Default Masks: {count} declared', recomputed on each render so sibling-tab AuthorizationStateNotifier mutations refresh the count without a manual callback. Scroll height bumped to 28rem because DefaultMasks has no separate details surface pulling eye-height away from the grid, so the grid itself gets a bit more viewport. No invented details editor -- per the plan's guardrail 'Do not invent a fake details editor just to force parity'.

Updated two existing Playwright tests that interact with the grid after row selection: UsersAndRoleAssignmentWorkflowTests.CrossOrgUserAdmin_AssignsBackofficeUser_ToSeededCustomerAsync re-expands the shell (click users-and-role-assignment-shell-header) before asserting the new role chip on the grid row -- MudExpansionPanel's collapsed content is not visible to Playwright's ToBeVisibleAsync; and SecurityDashboardUatCoverageTests.OrgMasterDetails_CreateOrganization_GridRefreshesInCircuitAsync re-expands the organization-master-details-shell-header between save and the 'new row visible' assertion. All other dashboard tests kept working on the initial-expanded state (they do a single row interaction then move to the details surface below).
